name: Wings of Winter
source:
Every year, Serafina finds herself observing birds migrating south for the winter from the warmth and comfort of her home, all while secretly wishing she was among them.

She thought she had already accepted her sheltered and mundane life, but the arrival of a wild bird ushers in a fresh new perspective that challenges her to reconsider her truth.

Whether this winter will be different depends on Serafina's choices in these next five days. The final outcome is in your hands.

[From [url=https://hamfistedgames.itch.io/wings-of-winter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每年，塞拉菲娜都会发现自己在温暖舒适的家中观察鸟类向南方迁徙过冬，同时暗自希望自己也在其中。

她以为自己已经接受了受庇护的平凡生活，但一只野鸟的到来给她带来了一个全新的视角，挑战她重新考虑自己的真相。

这个冬天是否会有所不同，取决于塞拉菲娜接下来五天的选择。最终的结果掌握在你的手中。

[来自[url=https://hamfistedgames.itch.io/wings-of-winter]itch.io[/url]]
